name: pstack
description: A Claude Code port of pstack, Lauren Tan's agent workflows: if you want to go fast, go deep first. Write less, but higher quality code, with rigorous workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

work_model.title: Work model
work_model.description: Model for the Work setting: code delegates, arena runners, unit workers and sub-leads. Effort is fixed at medium.

judgement_model.title: Judgement model
judgement_model.description: Model for the Judgement setting: the hardest tasks, judges, reviewers and fresh-context reviews. Effort is fixed at high.

volume_model.title: Volume model
volume_model.description: Model for the Volume setting: swarm and first-pass race workers, and other Volume roles. Effort is fixed at high.
